reviews.body:
Confirmed on main: `geminiUsageTokens` ignored `toolUsePromptTokenCount`, so built-in tool tokens (Google Search, URL context, code execution) were dropped from input usage and cost. Your test fails on main (150) and passes with the fix.

I pushed one follow-up commit: the non-streaming OpenAI-compat mapping (`geminiUsageToOpenai`) reads raw `promptTokenCount`, so after this change a streamed request would report larger `prompt_tokens` than the same request unstreamed. It now adds the tool-use tokens too, with a stream/non-stream parity test. Thanks!
